Krewe of Shamrock Charity Raffles

Gift-ready baskets from donated treasures — raise funds for charity ☘

🎁 How gift-basket raffles work

  1. Browse the themed, gift-ready baskets below (donated contents — themes, bottles, or a single treasure).
  2. Enter your name and how many tickets you want for that basket.
  3. Each ticket is one entry in that basket. Draws happen in person at the event.
  4. Proceeds support charity. Members also use this page as a planning board while baskets come together.

💰 How the 50/50 works

  1. Buy 50/50 tickets in any amount.
  2. All tickets go into one pot.
  3. One ticket is drawn in person at the event.
  4. The winner takes half the pot; the other half supports charity.
Paying: Tickets are tracked digitally; payment is in person. Settle up with any Krewe volunteer at the table (cash or card). Your entries are recorded when you submit — a volunteer confirms payment before the draw. Sláinte! 🍀
